description: This file defines the ObsService interface in the OpenMRS project, which provides methods for managing and retrieving observations (Obs) in a medical records system. It includes method signatures for CRUD operations, querying observations based on various criteria, managing complex observation handlers, and counting observations.

classes.name: ObsService
classes.description: Interface defining services for handling medical observations (Obs) within the OpenMRS system, including CRUD operations, complex data handling, and querying functionalities.

methods.name: setObsDAO
methods.description: Sets the Data Access Object for observations.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves an observation by its integer ID.

methods.name: getObsByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an observation by its UUID.

methods.name: getRevisionObs
methods.description: Gets the revision observation for an initial observation.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves a given observation, handling creation or update logic.

methods.name: voidObs
methods.description: Voids (deletes) an observation with a specified reason.

methods.name: unvoidObs
methods.description: Reverses a voided (deleted) observation.

methods.name: purgeObs
methods.description: Completely removes an observation from the database.

methods.name: purgeObs
methods.description: Removes an observation from the database with cascade option.

methods.name: getObservationsByPerson
methods.description: Fetches all non-voided observations for a specific person.

methods.name: getObservations
methods.description: Retrieves observations based on multiple filtering criteria.

methods.name: getObservationCount
methods.description: Counts observations matching given criteria.

methods.name: getObservations
methods.description: Fetches observations matching given string search.

methods.name: getObservationsByPersonAndConcept
methods.description: Gets non-voided observations for a person with a particular concept.

methods.name: getComplexObs
methods.description: Retrieves a complex observation with its data.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Gets the registered handler for complex observations by key.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Gets the handler for a complex observation.

methods.name: setHandlers
methods.description: Sets multiple complex observation handlers at once.

methods.name: getHandlers
methods.description: Retrieves all registered complex observation handlers.

methods.name: registerHandler
methods.description: Registers a handler with a specific key.

methods.name: registerHandler
methods.description: Loads and registers a handler class with a specific key.

methods.name: removeHandler
methods.description: Removes a handler associated with a key.

methods.name: getObservationCount
methods.description: Counts observations based on concept names, including voided ones.

methods.name: getObservations
methods.description: Retrieves observations including visit context, based on multiple criteria.

methods.name: getObservationCount
methods.description: Counts observations including visit context, based on multiple criteria.
